# Zenith Digital

> Zenith Digital is a Wix Studio web design agency based in Belgrade, Serbia,
> serving clients across the UK, EU, and US. Wix Legend Partner, the top tier of
> the Wix Partner programme. 100+ websites shipped since 2019, €1M+ in campaign
> revenue across the MOD Digital partnership, 5.96x average ROAS on managed
> campaigns. Founded in 2021 and run by
> Pavle Maodus. The agency builds custom-coded sites (Next.js) for clients who
> outgrow Wix Studio, including this site.

## Services

- [Wix Studio website design](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/services/wix-studio-website-design): custom conversion-first builds from €1,250, launched in 2 to 5 weeks
- [Website migration](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/services/website-migration): hub for moving to Wix Studio from Wix Classic, Squarespace, WordPress, Webflow, Framer, or Wix Harmony, with zero ranking loss, from €1,250
  - [Wix Classic to Wix Studio](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/services/wix-classic-to-wix-studio): since May 2026 a Wix Editor site can branch to Studio, sharing the dashboard, business data and apps, but the design is not carried over and is rebuilt, and publishing the branch unpublishes the Editor site for good. Covers the branch and fresh-build routes, with a table of what carries over and what is rebuilt, sourced to Wix documentation
  - [Squarespace to Wix Studio](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/services/squarespace-to-wix-studio): what Squarespace's WordPress-format XML export actually contains and the page types, blocks, products, and settings it omits, plus why every blog post URL changes
  - [Wix Harmony to Wix Studio](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/services/wix-harmony-to-wix-studio): Wix states a Harmony site cannot be transferred to the Wix Editor or Studio Editor, and Harmony ships without the CMS and Wix Multilingual. Guide to the rebuild and to choosing between Harmony and Studio up front
- [Landing pages](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/services/landing-pages): campaign landing pages live in about a week, from €750
- [Wix Studio development](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/services/wix-studio-development): Velo custom code, CMS architecture, integrations, automations, and marketplace platforms built natively on Wix Studio, quoted per project
- [SEO, AEO & PPC](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/services/seo-aeo-ppc): search, answer-engine optimization, and paid campaigns for Wix Studio sites
- [White-label & partnerships](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/partnerships): unbranded production for agencies, landing pages from €600, retainers from €1,099/mo

## Industries

- [Industries](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries): hub listing every industry Zenith Digital builds for, with the projects shipped in each
  - [Travel](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries/travel): websites for travel agencies, tour operators and holiday rentals that take bookings and enquiries direct; Scottish Luxury Experience ($521k in booked trips in 7 months, with MOD Digital), Bel'Istria, Just Stay
  - [E-commerce](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries/ecommerce): online stores on Wix Studio and Shopify for product brands, drops and producers selling direct, including multi-language stores
  - [SaaS and AI](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries/saas): marketing sites for SaaS and AI startups, on Wix Studio or custom code with Sanity; Knode AI (10 pages in 3 weeks), Genroks AI (10+ ISO deals since launch)
  - [Coaches](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries/coaches): websites for coaches, speakers, practitioners and authors with class, retreat and speaker bookings; Katie Hailey (Figma to live in 1.5 weeks)
  - [Courses](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries/courses): course websites, launch pages and searchable libraries; Hunting Brook Gardens (€140k in course and event sales, with MOD Digital)
  - [Property](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries/property): websites for estate agencies, developers and property services with searchable listings and enquiry routing
  - [Marine](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries/marine): boat and yacht marketplaces, brokers, charters and dock rentals; Yacht Junky, a multi-seller marketplace built natively in Wix Studio
  - [Trades](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries/trades): quote-led websites for trades, contractors and logistics firms, with service and area pages
  - [Professional services](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries/professional-services): websites for consultancies and service firms, in English, German or Serbian
  - [Creative](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries/creative): portfolio websites for film crews, video production companies and creative studios
  - [Local business](https://www.thezenithdigital.com/industries/local-business): websites for barbers, restaurants, shops and local services with prices, hours and booking or ordering
